en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a small town nestled on a forested hillside. In the foreground are trees and fields; behind them stand scattered houses, villas, and a few larger buildings with steep roofs. A small church or chapel tower is visible among the buildings. Dense coniferous forest covers the large hill rising behind the town. Printed text in German appears at the top of the card.
